request.description: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful. Light: the sun is low in the south-west, at the bottom left of the image: faces turned to the left or to the viewer are lit, faces turned to the right are in shadow, snow is brightest on its left side, and nothing is lit from the right. Class: one bold chunky game mascot sprite with a single clear subject and a big simple silhouette that still reads as a tiny browser tab picture of 16 pixels, thick single-colour black outline, big simple shapes and flat colours with one shadow tone, very few details. The subject fills almost the whole square with only a one or two pixel margin and floats alone on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn behind or under it. Subject: the head of a chunky cute cheeky goblin, the mascot of the game, facing the viewer and turned a little to the right: a huge round head with bright lime green skin, colour #86c232, lighter #acdc55 on the face and darker #5a9424 shading, two huge pointed ears sticking straight out sideways to the edges of the image, big round cream eyes with black pupils, a long pointy nose and a wide toothy grin, a small pale sand-buff leather cap; only the head and a short neck, no body, no hands, nothing else in the image. Must not include: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject, icon frame, round badge, medallion, coin-shaped backdrop, button, border, circular background, square background, vignette, background scenery, ground tile, grass square, pedestal, many small objects, body, shoulders, hands, weapon, red cloth, skull, horror, grey skin.
